decisions.reason: The DPA management tool fits the firm's stated compliance and agency focus, has a dedicated page and positive customer feedback on its agency templates, and costs little to carry in a growing industry, so results appear to meet the aspiration.

The management platform is featured on the home page and is central to the agency-platform strategy, which signals satisfactory performance and strategic commitment, so there is no trigger for problemistic search.

The configurable managed plan sits close to the core hosting offer and is presented on its own page, and with industry growth providing slack there is no evident shortfall that would justify withdrawing it.
